instructions: Answer any three out of the remaining five questions.
Assume any suitable data wherever required and justify the same.

questions.label: 1a
questions.text: What is the basic difference between traditional RDBMS and Hadoop?

questions.label: 1b
questions.text: What are the 3 V's of big data? Give two big data case studies indicating respective V's with justification.

questions.label: 1c
questions.text: Explain how node failure is handled in Hadoop.

questions.label: 1d
questions.text: List down all six constraints that must be satisfied for representing a stream by buckets using DGIM algorithm with examples.

questions.label: 2a
questions.text: Describe the four ways by which big data problems are handled by NoSQL.

questions.label: 2b
questions.text:
Write a map reduce pseudo code to multiply two matrices. Apply map reduce working to perform following matrix multiplication.

$$
M = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 2 & 3 \\ 4 & 5 & 6 \\ 7 & 8 & 9 \end{bmatrix} \times V = \begin{bmatrix} 1 \\ 2 \\ 3 \end{bmatrix}
$$

questions.label: 3a
questions.text: Suppose the stream is S = \{4, 2, 5, 9, 1, 6, 3, 7\}. Let hash functions h(x) = x + 6 mod 32 for some a and b, treat result as a 5-bit binary integer. Show how the Flajolet-Martin algorithm will estimate the number of distinct elements in this stream.

questions.label: 3b
questions.text:
i. Create a data frame from the following 4 vectors and demonstrate the output:

```r
emp_id = c(1:5)
emp_name = c("Rick","Dan","Michelle","Ryan","Gary")
start_date = c("2012-01-01", "2013-09-23", "2014-11-15", "2014-05-11", "2015-03-27")
salary = c(60000, 45000, 75000, 84000, 20000)
```

ii. Display structure and summary of the above data frame.

iii. Extract the emp_name and salary columns from the above data frame.

iv. Extract the employee details whose salary is less than or equal to 60000.

questions.label: 4a
questions.text: Explain Map Reduce execution pipeline with suitable example.

questions.label: 4b
questions.text: Explain DGIM algorithm for counting ones in a stream with example.

questions.label: 5a
questions.text: Determine communities for the given social network graph using Girvan-Newman algorithm.
questions.note: Graph in the paper, edges: A-B, A-C, B-C, B-D, D-E, D-F, D-G, E-F, F-G.

questions.label: 5b
questions.text: List and explain various functions that allow users to handle data in R workspace with appropriate examples.

questions.label: 6a
questions.text:
i. What are the advantages of using functions over scripts?

ii. Suppose you have two datasets A and B. Dataset A has the following data: 6 7 8 9. Dataset B has the following data: 1 2 4 5. Which function is used to combine the data from both datasets into dataset C? Demonstrate the function with the input values and write the output.

questions.label: 6b
questions.text: How recommendation is done based on properties of the product? Explain with the help of an example.
